name: Illness
overview: Scripture reveals that the Lord provides strength, peace, and preservation to His people amid illness, including mental and terminal conditions. The Psalms affirm that God hears the cries of the righteous and sustains them through their suffering, strengthening them even in their weakest moments. Isaiah emphasizes the perfect peace granted to those who fix their minds on God, while Matthew highlights Christ’s redemptive work in bearing our infirmities and sicknesses, demonstrating His intimate involvement in human suffering.
